description: Test file for verifying import safety in setup helpers. It uses vitest for mocking and testing import behavior of setup-helpers module, ensuring that certain modules load lazily and do not get imported unintentionally during setup.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Resets mocks and cache after each test to ensure test isolation.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for setup helper import safety.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines a test case that checks that the discovery module is not loaded on import.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertions to verify expected behavior in tests.

methods.name: vi.doUnmock
methods.description: Removes mock for the specified module after each test.

methods.name: vi.doMock
methods.description: Mocks a module to simulate lazy loading behavior.

methods.name: importFreshModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports a module fresh, bypassing cache for testing.
